notes.title: Buried Bone
notes.content:
Fixed all hammer so it exhausts properly
Adjusted balance so the start of the game is easier but getting to year 5 is more of a challenge

fighting with a skeleton that keeps finding all my secrets achievements and bugs included so I've added it to my game as an easter egg. have fun getting swarmed by skeletons and then single handedly destroying them all.

notes.title: A Koi little update
notes.content: very small update inspired by the First guide for the game happy achievement hunting

notes.title: patch 1.3.8 loading bugs
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where sunflowers could be saved and loaded to give infinite energy
fixed a bug where ruins would give treasure when loaded 
fixed a bug where ships would give fish and treasure when loaded 
updated highlighting on standing stone

notes.title: Patch 1.3.7 Mid Game Saving
notes.content: you can now save during a game

notes.title: patch v1.3.6 Draw
notes.content: quick patch to allow draw to work like before when draw and discard deck are empty allowing cards to draw themselfs

notes.title: patch 1.3.5
notes.content:
complete over hall of card data and card reader
update to exhaust to be more consistent 
update to On Discard to allow more key words to work with it.
update to trout and manta ray to exhaust on discard 
update to card text for on discard to be consistent across all cards.

notes.title: Reverting patch 1.3.4 to 1.3.3
notes.content: there is a bug where exhaust cards don't exhaust will patch shortly and readd fishing changes

notes.title: patch 1.3.4 Discard Changes
notes.content:
updated tuna manta and old boot card to allow them to be exhausted when discarded.
fixed card text so all on discard card use "on Discard" key word
Fixed bug with discard keyword getting confused with on discard key word.

notes.title: v1.3.3 patch
notes.content: fixed card text for ruby tile

notes.title: Patch to 1.3.0
notes.content:
Fixed bug with standing stone trying to upgrade tiles at the edge of the board
Updated gone fishing achievement to require you to actually catch a fish
Sword can be used on fox and the panda now. you monster 
fixed bug with tile menu where it would reset on the first turn and forget saved tiles

notes.title: small update to fail text
notes.content:
the pay taxes button now says cant pay if you can no longer pay 
added safe guards to the button just incase it could be clicked twice 

removed laser eyes from the evil rabbit as this was too op 
that last one might be a lie

notes.title: Text Settings
notes.content: added new setting to change the retro font to a more readable larger font in the settings menu

notes.title: small patch from suggestion
notes.content: quit in the menus now exits the application instead of resigning. return to menu menu can be used to restart a new game

notes.title: Achievement bug
notes.content:
fixed a bug where the game would no longer save after completing 5 years achievement.
updated gold text to shorten when extra long

fixed tutorial bug
card text update

4 new achievements
tweaks to tile effects

notes.title: Potato's are not Trees "obviously"
notes.content:
Updated potato tile so it no longer get consumed by the lumber yard
Updated bamboo so it now can be consumed by the lumber yard 
Fixed graphical bug where the card drawn to hand was the last card until it was in the hand
Cards now get added to the right hand side of  hand instead of left
